title: Determining Sentiment Intensity of English and Arabic Phrases
description: Determine the sentiment intensity of English and Arabic phrases using Best-Worst Scaling: annotators see four phrases at a time and select the most positive and most negative, which are aggregated into real-valued intensity scores in [0,1]. Based on SemEval-2016 Task 7.
